LanguageData.OA_ConfirmDiplomaticSummit: Your negotiator will have an expected two-hour and difficult negotiation with the court officials of {SETLEment_label}. If you succeed, you will receive more assistance. However, if you fail or leave midway, your relationship with the local court will deteriorate. Are you sure?
LanguageData.OA_ConfirmDiplomaticSummitInfo: After careful consideration by your negotiators, you have formally requested more assistance from the court of {SETLEment_label} and conducted a diplomatic negotiation to determine the final outcome. Under your strong demands, the Golden Iris Orchid Palace finally agreed to your request and specially arranged a negotiation conference room for you.
LanguageData.OA_DiplomaticSummitNegotiatingTeamLevelB: ......\n\nWhen you step into the conference room, you observe that your opponent is noticeably more nervous compared to you in away negotiations. And at the beginning of the negotiation, they made some tactical mistakes due to nervousness, perhaps this meeting will be more beneficial to you.
LanguageData.OA_DiplomaticSummitNegotiatingTeamLevelS: ......\n\nWhen you enter the conference room, you observe that your opponents seem to be fully prepared for the upcoming negotiations. They are whispering to each other, seemingly discussing relevant language, and perhaps this meeting will be a evenly matched negotiation

......\n\nWhen you step into the conference room, you observe that your opponent seems confident. When they politely greet you, you notice that your relevant information has already been placed in front of their table. Perhaps this meeting will be a difficult negotiation.
LanguageData.OA_DiplomaticSummitNegotiatingTeamLevelE: ......\n\nWhen you step into the conference room, you can't see the mentality of your opponents towards this negotiation at all. LanguageData.OA_LetterDiplomaticSummit_LeaveHalfway: During the negotiation, your negotiator used some clumsy excuses as an excuse to leave the negotiation room and never returned.\n\nGoodwill with {1}: {2}
LanguageData.OA_LetterDiplomaticSummit_Disaster:
Despite your negotiator's repeated attempts to salvage the situation, your opponent relentlessly pursued you time and time again, to the point where it eventually evolved into a unilateral and ruthless criticism of your unreasonable demands. At the end of this negotiation, the outcome was already quite clear: 

Most of your demands have been rejected by the court of {SETLEment_label} with valid reasons, while a few excessive demands are seen as insults to {1} and disrespect for your alliance, ultimately leading to a significant deterioration in the court's perception of you. 

Favorability with {1}: {2} \ n \ n The support points will not naturally increase in the next {3} days.
LanguageData.OA_LetterDiplomaticSummit_Success:
In this negotiation, you and your opponents are constantly questioning and refuting each other, in order to seek the maximum benefits for each other's factions as much as possible. After the intense battle between words and intellect ended, your negotiator won the following results for you: 

The court of {SETLEment_label} agreed to some of your demands and deemed them reasonable. However, regarding the small amount of unreasonable demands made by your negotiators, the court of {SETLEment_label} believed that these were just some negotiation methods and did not affect their perception of you.
